parts.name: Monocoque
parts.role: survival cell / chassis tub with nose and cockpit opening
parts.notes: Reused exactly as registered (v3). Do not rebuild, move or modify.

parts.name: Front wing
parts.role: front wing: main plane, flap(s), endplates; ahead of the front axle
parts.notes: Reused exactly as registered (v3). Do not rebuild, move or modify.

parts.name: Floor
parts.role: floor plate under the car with rear diffuser ramp
parts.notes: Reused exactly as registered (v2). Do not rebuild, move or modify.

parts.name: Rear wing
parts.role: rear wing: main plane, flap, endplates, central support
parts.notes: Reused exactly as registered (v2). Do not rebuild, move or modify.

parts.name: Wheel front left
parts.role: front-left wheel and tyre on the front axle (X=0), +Y side
parts.notes: Axle along the part-local Y axis through the local origin (wheel centre); rotationally symmetric about it. Tyre cylinder r=360 from y=-150 (inner face) to y=+150 (outer face), rounded shoulders r=40. Outboard (+Y) rim face recessed 25 mm, rim disc dia 460 (silver), tyre near-black. Hub boss on the inboard (-Y) side: r=90 from y=-150 to y=-210, flat end face at y=-210 (suspension contact plane). One connected solid.

parts.name: Wheel front right
parts.role: front-right wheel and tyre on the front axle (X=0), -Y side

parts.name: Wheel rear left
parts.role: rear-left wheel and tyre on the rear axle, +Y side
parts.notes: Axle along the part-local Y axis through the local origin (wheel centre); rotationally symmetric about it. Tyre cylinder r=370 from y=-190 (inner face) to y=+190 (outer face), rounded shoulders r=45. Outboard (+Y) rim face recessed 25 mm, rim disc dia 480 (silver), tyre near-black. Hub boss on the inboard (-Y) side: r=90 from y=-190 to y=-250, flat end face at y=-250 (suspension contact plane). One connected solid.

parts.name: Wheel rear right
parts.role: rear-right wheel and tyre on the rear axle, -Y side

parts.name: Front suspension left
parts.role: front-left suspension links: monocoque to WHL-FL
parts.notes: Origin = hub-boss end plane at wheel centre. 30 mm square beams, dark grey, one solid. Lower wishbone: outboard node (0,0,-60), inboard legs to (85,-440,-240) and (-280,-375,-240). Upper wishbone: outboard node (0,0,+60), legs to (85,-440,-180) and (-280,-375,-180). Outboard ends cut flat on plane y=0 (within r=90 of origin, touching hub boss). Inboard ends cut on Y-planes, ~10 mm into monocoque wall. Pushrod 25 mm square from lower outboard node (0,-30,-60) to upper wishbone near (-100,-330,-175).

parts.name: Front suspension right
parts.role: front-right suspension links: monocoque to WHL-FR

parts.name: Rear suspension left
parts.role: rear-left suspension links: car body to WHL-RL
parts.notes: Origin = hub-boss end plane at wheel centre. 30 mm square beams, dark grey, one solid. Lower wishbone: outboard node (0,0,-60), legs to (+110,-74,-170) and (-110,-74,-170). Upper: outboard node (0,0,+60), legs to (+110,-74,+100) and (-110,-74,+100). Outboard ends cut flat on plane y=0 inside r=90 (touching hub boss). Inboard ends cut on plane y=-74, ~10 mm into monocoque side wall; keep all inboard material within x -150..+150. Pushrod 25 mm square from lower outboard node to upper wishbone inboard region.

parts.name: Rear suspension right
parts.role: rear-right suspension links: car body to WHL-RR

parts.name: Sidepod left
parts.role: left sidepod bodywork with radiator inlet, beside the monocoque
parts.notes: Loft of sections from x=0 (front) to x=-2250 (rear), flat bottom on z=0. Inner wall y: 280 @x0, 372 @x-700, 426 @x-1900, 431 @x-2250. Outer wall y: 660 @x0, 700 @x-500, linear to 540 @x-2250. Top z: 370 @x0, 390 @x-1100, 270 @x-2250; 40 mm top fillets. Front face pocket 200(y) x 150(z) x 120 deep centred y=470, z=220. Outer lower undercut: inset 60 mm, 120 high, keep bottom face continuous. Red as monocoque. One solid.

parts.name: Sidepod right
parts.role: right sidepod bodywork with radiator inlet, beside the monocoque

parts.name: Engine cover
parts.role: power unit / engine cover behind the cockpit, above the floor
parts.notes: Base plane z=0 (embeds into monocoque top). Airbox x 0..-250, |y|<=140, height to z=320, rounded edges; front intake opening 180 wide x 140 high, 100 deep, centred z=230 in the front face (x=0). Shark-fin spine |y|<=40 from x=-250 to x=-1150, top falling linearly from z=320 to z=120 at x=-1150. Airbox and spine one fused solid, red as monocoque. Keep x>=-1150 (clear of rear wing).

parts.name: Halo
parts.role: halo cockpit protection hoop over the cockpit opening
parts.notes: Origin = front pillar foot centre on rim plane. Two side bars 40 mm section: rear feet centred (-860,±280,0), rising to hoop centreline z=140 (top surface z=160), running forward at |y|<=280 and curving inward to meet at (~-90,0,140). Front pillar 60 wide x 40 from that junction down to foot centred (0,0,0). Feet bottoms flat exactly on z=0. Dark grey, one solid.

parts.name: Mirror left
parts.role: left rear-view mirror housing on its stalk beside the cockpit
parts.notes: Origin = housing centre. Housing box x -20..20, y -80..80, z -40..40, small edge fillets. Stalk 30(x) x 20(z) from y=-80 inboard to y=-174, base embedded ~10 mm into monocoque side. Black. One solid; keep clear of halo and sidepod.

parts.name: Mirror right
parts.role: right rear-view mirror housing on its stalk beside the cockpit

assumptions: Sidepod outer wall at the front face (X=-700) is |Y|=660, widening to 700 at X=-1200.
Monocoque side walls are treated as vertical at the brief's half-widths; suspension and mirror inboard ends are embedded about 10 mm based on those values.
Wheel rim disc diameter is 460 front / 480 rear with a 25 mm recess; tyre shoulder radii are 40 / 45 mm.
Suspension outboard nodes sit 60 mm above and below the wheel centre at X of the axle; pushrod section is 25 mm square, joining the lower outboard node to the upper wishbone.
Halo hoop centreline is at Z 880 (top surface Z 900); the front pillar section is 60 x 40 mm.
Airbox intake opening is 180 x 140 mm and 100 mm deep; the spine is 80 mm wide, with its top falling linearly from Z 1000 to Z 800.
Sidepod inlet pocket is centred at |Y| 470, Z 250; the outer lower undercut is 60 mm deep and 120 mm high; top fillet is 40 mm.
Mirror stalk section is 30 x 20 mm with its base at |Y| about 386, where the monocoque half-width is about 396 at X -1700.
